```
M 44.39,14.63 L 57.18,30.28
L 57.18,30.28 L 77.37,27.19
```

1. First segment:  
   M 77.37,27.19 → L 75.57,16.98 → L 55.39,21.31 → L 44.39,14.63  
   This draws a connected line through 4 points.

2. Second segment:  
   M 44.39,14.63 → L 57.18,30.28  
   This moves to the last point of the first segment and draws a line to a new point.

3. Third segment:  
   L 57.18,30.28 → L 77.37,27.19  
   This continues from the previous point and draws a line back to the starting point (77.37,27.19).

So the overall shape has vertices:  
(77.37,27.19), (75.57,16.98), (55.39,21.31), (44.39,14.63), (57.18,30.28), and back to (77.37,27.19).

That's 5 distinct vertices:  
1. (77.37,27.19)  
2. (75.57,16.98)  
3. (55.39,21.31)  
4. (44.39,14.63)  
5. (57.18,30.28)  

A closed shape with 5 vertices is a pentagon.
